summary: Kontoor Brands filed an 8-K announcing a Stock Purchase Agreement to sell its wholly-owned subsidiary, The H.D. Lee Company, Inc. (Lee), to ABG-Storm LLC (an affiliate of Authentic Brands Group) for $750M cash at closing plus a potential $250M earnout over five years. The board unanimously approved the deal. Closing expected in H2 2026, subject to regulatory approvals, customary conditions, and a pre-closing reorganization. The company intends to use proceeds for debt reduction and share repurchases. The agreement includes termination rights through February 1, 2027. Watch for regulatory clearance and any material adverse effect on Lee's business.
